Always open

No deadline to work against. Apply when ready.

  • Ethereum Foundation ESP

    Wishlist and RFP tracks

    Scoped, ETH-denominated · 3 to 6 week review

    No open rounds at present; RFPs published on the portal.

  • Solana Foundation Grants

    Milestone and convertible

    About 1 week to review, 3 weeks to decision

    Public-goods milestone grants plus convertible grants for commercial public goods, and an RFP board.

  • Starknet Seed and Growth Grants

    Starknet Foundation

    Seed up to $25k · Growth $25k to $1M in STRK

    Bitcoin Builder, Content and Creator and Next Billion sub-tracks.

  • Aptos Ecosystem Grants

    Aptos Foundation

    $5k to $50k, milestone-based

    Separate payments grant track. Reviewed on a rolling basis.

  • Base Ecosystem Fund

    Coinbase Ventures

    Pre-seed and seed, equity or token

    Batches run about twice a year.

  • Filecoin Open Grants

    Filecoin Foundation

    Next Step $5k to $10k · Open Grants scoped

    Three-month review cycle.

  • HRF Bitcoin Development Fund

    Human Rights Foundation

    Case by case · quarterly announcements

    Freedom tech, privacy and censorship resistance.

  • NVIDIA Inception

    NVIDIA · no cohorts, no equity

    Credits, hardware pricing, investor introductions

    Under 10 years old, incorporated, at least one developer. Excludes crypto companies.

  • Google Cloud AI startup program

    Google Cloud

    Up to $350k in credits over two years

    Built on Gemini or Gemma, venture-funded, under five years old.

  • AWS Activate

    Amazon Web Services

    Up to $200k in credits

    Five to ten business day response.

  • Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub

    Microsoft

    Tiered Azure credits to $150k

    Credits usable across eligible Azure services, plus access to AI models and tools.

  • NAIRR Pilot resource requests

    NSF and partners

    Compute, model and data allocations

    Not cash. Submit by the 15th, decision by the end of the following month.

  • UKRI AIRR: Isambard-AI and Dawn

    UK Research and Innovation

    Up to 10,000 GPU hours per project

    Gateway route open with no closing date. UK businesses of any size, research bodies and charities eligible. Batched fortnightly; hours run on Isambard-AI and Zenith.

  • Antler global residencies

    Antler · 25+ cities

    About $100k to $250k for about 8% to 10%

    Published dates are cohort start dates, not deadlines; Antler asks founders to apply early to secure a seat.

  • Outlier Ventures Base Camp

    Outlier Ventures

    Up to $100k stipend plus up to $200k follow-on, for equity and future token supply

    Web3 plus AI x Crypto, DeFi, RWA and DePIN. Twelve weeks, remote. The call for builders page currently shows applications closed.

  • BNB Chain MVB / YZi Labs

    BNB Chain · about three cohorts a year

    Typically $100k to $500k at selection

    Four-week accelerator with investment for top builders.

  • Z Fellows

    Z Fellows

    $10k at a $1B valuation cap

    Idea and pre-seed stage, one week long.

  • Coefficient Giving

    Formerly Open Philanthropy

    Capacity-building and career transition

    Renamed from Open Philanthropy in 2025. The AI risk capacity-building fund is open on a rolling basis; other AI RFPs carry their own status.

  • Transformative AI Fund

    EA Funds

    Typically $10k to $150k, rarely above $300k

    Replaces the Long-Term Future Fund. Always open to applications.

  • Arbitrum Audit Program

    Arbitrum Foundation

    $10M ARB over 12 months

    Audit Program applications closed 31 Jul 2026. The successor Arbitrum Security Program runs 12 more months on rolling applications from the remaining budget.
